title: 25 老二26 赚钱27 怒风
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位
content_zh:
;;
而在齐知玄的棍棒教育下，鲍怜花不负期望，潜能得到极大的释放，实力突飞猛进。
遥遥领先！
没有意外的话，半个月内，她必能血流境大成。
甚至。
白云霄断言，鲍怜花能在两个月内通过搬血三关。
毕竟宋伦之前就说过，根骨在中等之上，可在三个月内通过搬血三关，遑论鲍怜花这般惊艳资质。
“嗯，差不多了。”
在接连揍了鲍怜花两天后，齐知玄眼见自己已经将她的武学天分尽数压榨出来，决定不装了，摊牌了。
他要做第二个突破的。
拿下第二名！
放在之前，第二名对于齐知玄而言，绝对足够耀眼，未必是好事。
但现在情况不同了。
两个装备栏开启，给了齐知玄前所未有的底气。
“齐师兄，你也突破了！”
一直在挨揍的鲍怜花，脸上涌现莫大的感动之色。
“终于！”
“我每时每刻都在期盼你突破呢！”
鲍怜花呲着牙，弹了弹身上的灰尘，默默从挎包里掏出一根鞭子。
齐知玄头皮发麻，错愕道：“鲍师妹，你这是想干什么？”

鲍怜花咧开嘴角，哈哈笑道：“为了齐师兄能够走上人生巅峰，我必须让你感受到痛苦。”
齐知玄连道：“我们应该用木棍进行对练，你拿鞭子做什么？”
啪！
鲍怜花甩动鞭子，抽在地上，亢奋道：“木棍已经无法表达我对你的期望。”
“唯有鞭子才能彰显正义！”
说着，鲍怜花舞动鞭子，疯狂抽打齐知玄。
“我勒个去！”
齐知玄心神一紧，迅速搬运体内气血，按照鞭子击打的轨迹，预测身体可能遭到伤害的部位，让气血提前聚集到相应的位置。
啪！
一鞭子抽下来，从肩膀到后腰。
痛死了！
齐知玄没有完全防御下来，实际挨打的位置与他预测的位置存在偏差。
鞭子嘛，本就不好预测其轨迹。
这十分考验眼力，气血搬运的速度和准度。
“哎呦呦，师妹手下留情。”
content_en:
;;
Under Qi Zhixuan's stick education, Bao Lianhua lived up to expectations, her potential was greatly released, and her strength improved by leaps and bounds.
Far ahead!
If there are no accidents, within half a month, she will be able to achieve great success in the Blood Flow Realm.
even.
Bai Yunxiao asserted that Bao Lianhua could pass the three blood-moving tests within two months.
After all, Song Lun had said before that with an above-average level of bones, he could pass the three blood-moving levels within three months, let alone Bao Lianhua's amazing qualifications.
"Well, that's almost it."
After beating Bao Lianhua for two days, Qi Zhixuan saw that he had squeezed out all her martial arts talent, so he decided not to pretend anymore and showed his cards.
He wants to make the second breakthrough.
Get second place!
Compared to the previous ones, second place is definitely dazzling enough for Qi Zhixuan, which may not be a good thing.
But things are different now.
The two equipment slots were opened, giving Qi Zhixuan unprecedented confidence.
"Senior Brother Qi, you have also made a breakthrough!"
Bao Lianhua, who had been beaten all the time, had a look of great emotion on her face.
"Finally!"
"I'm looking forward to your breakthrough every moment!"
Bao Lianhua gritted her teeth, flicked the dust off her body, and silently took out a whip from her satchel.
Qi Zhixuan's scalp was numb and he asked in shock: "Junior sister Bao, what do you want to do?"
Bao Lianhua grinned and laughed: "In order for Senior Brother Qi to reach the top of his life, I must make you feel pain."
Qi Zhixuan said: "We should use wooden sticks for sparring. What are you doing with a whip?"
Snap!
Bao Lianhua swung the whip, slapped it on the ground, and said excitedly: "The wooden stick can no longer express my expectations for you."
"Only the whip can show justice!"
As he spoke, Bao Lianhua waved his whip and beat Qi Zhixuan crazily.
"I'll choke you!"
Qi Zhixuan's mind tightened, and he quickly moved the qi and blood in his body. According to the trajectory of the whip, he predicted the parts of the body that might be injured, so that the qi and blood could be gathered at the corresponding location in advance.
Snap!
The whip was drawn down from the shoulders to the lower back.
It hurts like hell!
Qi Zhixuan was not completely defensive, and the actual location where he was beaten differed from the location he predicted.
As for whips, it’s hard to predict their trajectory.
This is a great test of eyesight, speed and accuracy of Qi and blood transfer.
"Hey, junior sister, please be merciful."
